title: Paths between rooms
description:
Find the shortest way between rooms in a dungeon with breadth-first search.

```
rooms: hall-kitchen, hall-library, library-tower, kitchen-cellar
hall to tower: hall -> library -> tower (2 doors)
cellar to tower: cellar -> kitchen -> hall -> library -> tower
attic to hall: no way
```
hints: Mark a room visited when you push it, not when you pop it, so it is never queued twice (lesson 3.09).
Walk `cameFrom` back from `to` and reverse the result.
requirements: An adjacency list `std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>`; doors work both ways.
BFS with a queue and a "came from" map to rebuild the path.
Unknown rooms and unreachable rooms give a message.
stretch: Give doors a cost and switch to Dijkstra.
